content: {"praised":["Faithful adaptation preserves original story and holiday spirit.","Charming cast delivers engaging performances.","Traditional feel maintained with modern touches.","Good changes add variety to classic plot.","Positive portrayal of characters, especially the child."],"criticized":["Remake fails to capture original's cuteness and spirit.","New film portrays child as abused, unlike original.","Overall feel and look are lost in remake.","Remake considered worst, poorly executed.","Lacks the magic of the 1947 classic."]}
